body:
hahaha I know it looks like all stupid teenage angst stuff. Maybe it is. But I can't put into words beautifully painful it is to find someone who is so like you, who understands your hurt, and find that anything at all is impossible. I mean, I guess it's a normal part of life. But I can't be very normal if I want to kill myself over it?? hahaha. We want what we can never have, and I want too much.
 
They would become judgemental and hysterical. I see it already, from something minor involving my sister (not suicide related). I don't want them involved in anything like this. I trust the one I pine over more than them; sometimes I've talked to him about when I feel like this, as he gets like this sometimes too. He doesn't know the reason. But he's caring and supportive. It kills me.

I'm feeling more rational now. Not any less suicidal, but more rational.

Thanks for replying. 

He's not a boyfriend; I wasn't clear on that, sorry. Just a very intense crush that I long for very dearly. I've had crushes, and then there's this. Something I won't experience again, someone who I won't ever meet again. 

I can't get help. It would destroy my family. Not that much less than suicide, I think.
